final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM state_counts), state_shares AS (SELECT s.BillingState, s.invoice_count, 1.0 * s.invoice_count / t.total_count AS share FROM state_counts AS s JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM state_shares), kept AS (SELECT s.invoice_count, s.share, s.invoice_count - m.avg_share AS excess FROM state_shares AS s JOIN mean_share AS m ON m.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.invoice_count > m.avg_share) SELECT SUM(invoice_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM kept
